subject: Queryable admin-evidence handback & export options for SOC 2 / SIG
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@clearskyhealth.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 / SIG evidence - admin activity exports

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. ClearSky's compliance team is kicking off the SOC 2 Type II evidence collection and we've hit a couple of SIG/CAIQ questions that specifically ask for admin activity and audit-log evidence.

Can you confirm:
- Exactly which admin-events Redwood logs (fields and sample record format).
- Retention windows by event class (admin actions, operator sessions, model inference requests).
- Supported export formats (JSONL, Parquet, Parquet + manifest, streaming) and delivery channels (S3, SFTP, Kafka).
- Whether you can provide attestable manifests (checksums + HMAC) and chain-of-custody metadata for a snapshot export.

Ideally we want an indexable export (queryable by time range and actor) and a one-time snapshot for our auditor to ingest. Also need guidance on what PII is present and recommended redaction/pseudonymization approaches.

Attached is our SIG extract request (SIG_request_ClearSky_v2.pdf) — it highlights a few control IDs where they want event-level proof. Can we get a short plan/estimate for a one-time handback and what options exist for longer retention?

Cheers,
Jenna Park
Head of IT Security
ClearSky Health

Attachment: SIG_request_ClearSky_v2.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG evidence - admin activity exports

Hi Jenna — thanks for the note and the SIG excerpt. Looping in Ben (security ops), Kim (compliance), and Grace (product/exports) so we can answer precisely.

Quick summary up-front (we'll follow with a proposed handback playbook):
- What we log (sample fields): actor_id, actor_email (masked on request), actor_role, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, model_id, request_id, response_id, timestamp_utc, client_ip_range (CIDR truncated if requested), region, session_id, kv_cache_event (hit/miss/evict), tokens_generated, prompt_hash (SHA256 truncated), and auth_method.
- Retention (default): 90 days for full per-request payloads; 12 months for indexed metadata (actor, action, timestamp, resource). We can extend retention contracts on Dedicated/Private tiers.
- Export formats: JSONL (line-delimited), Parquet (columnar), gzipped CSV for quick audits. Delivery: S3 signed-delivery (AES-256), SFTP, or our streaming connector to a customer Kafka topic.
- Attestation: we produce a signed manifest (SHA256 per-file + HMAC with customer public key) and an export manifest.jsonl that includes file checksums, export time, and the query parameters used.

Open questions for you:
1) Do auditors need raw prompt text (we recommend pseudonymized prompt_hash + example scrubbed records)?
2) For the one-time snapshot, do you want a full payload export or an indexed subset (metadata + example payloads)?
3) Any jurisdictional redaction (EU PII locales) we should apply?

Next steps: Ben/Kim/Grace — can we put together a 1-page handback runbook and an attachment with the export schema and sample manifest? I can propose a timeline after that.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: export_schema_v1.csv (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG evidence - admin activity exports

Alex / team — technical notes to include in the runbook:
- Exact field defs (we should attach a small schema doc):
  * timestamp_utc (RFC3339)
  * actor_id (internal UUID)
  * actor_email (optional, pseudonymize on request)
  * action_type (enum: AUTH, ROLE_CHANGE, MODEL_DEPLOY, PROMPT_RUN, CACHE_EVICT, CONFIG_CHANGE)
  * resource_type/resource_id
  * request_id, response_id (UUIDs)
  * model_id and model_variant
  * token_counts (input_tokens, output_tokens)
  * client_ip (masked to /24 on request)
  * session_id
- Export options detail:
  Option A: One-time snapshot (full payload) — we can produce within 7 business days. Includes signed manifest and checksums.
  Option B: Queryable export endpoint — we expose temporary IAM-scoped credentials for an S3 path and a small API to re-run the original query. Good for auditor re-queries.
  Option C: Continuous streaming — we'd ship events to a customer-managed Kafka cluster (3-4 week setup for connector + auth).
- Retention: default 90d full payload / 12m index. For SOC 2 you commonly ask for 12m of indexed audit events; confirm if you need full payload retention that long.
- Chain-of-custody: HMAC manifests + signed delivery + signed timestamp envelope (we can provide a notarized hash if needed).

I'll draft the runbook and attach a redaction recipe (how we pseudonymize emails / truncate IPs / redact prompt text).

Ben Carter
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redaction_recipe.md (stub)

From: Jenna Park <jenna@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearskyhealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG evidence - admin activity exports

Thanks, Alex and Ben — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side (copied from auditor checklist):
- Requirement: 12 months retention of indexed admin events is mandatory for this engagement; full payload 90 days is acceptable if combined with a 12-month indexed summary that includes actor_id, action_type, resource_id, and request_id.
- For SIG/CAIQ: we need exports that map to the SIG question IDs (I included them in the attached PDF). The auditor will focus on CONTROL IDs SIG-AU-2 and SIG-EN-5.
- Pseudonymization: please replace actor_email with actor_pseudonym (hash with salt we provide). We can provide a recovery table under strict NDAs if needed.
- Delivery: prefer initial one-time snapshot (Parquet preferred) + signed manifest; also want the queryable endpoint for re-queries during audit window.

Can you confirm timelines and whether the manifest can include an HMAC using a key we control? Also confirm if timezone normalization to UTC will be applied (we need RFC3339 timestamps).

Jenna Park
Head of IT Security
ClearSky Health

Attachment: SIG_request_ClearSky_v2.pdf (re-sent)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG evidence - admin activity exports

Jenna — thanks, all answers below and a proposed plan.

Confirmations and plan:
- Retention: we'll deliver a one-time Parquet snapshot containing 90 days of full payload + an indexed Parquet of 12 months (actor_id/action_type/resource_id/request_id/timestamp). That matches your SOC 2 requirement.
- Pseudonymization: we can hash actor_email to actor_pseudonym using a salt you provide. We'll include a separate, encrypted recovery file (only shared under NDA / SFTP with your legal team).
- Manifest & HMAC: yes — we support HMAC using a customer-provided key. Manifest will include per-file SHA256 and a top-level HMAC envelope.
- Timezones: all timestamps normalized to UTC (RFC3339), plus an offset column with original_zone for traceability.

Delivery options & timeline:
1) One-time Parquet snapshot + signed manifest: estimated 7 business days from runbook sign-off. Files delivered to your S3 bucket (we'll provision a temporary write role).
2) Queryable endpoint for auditor re-queries: temporary credentials + S3 index, ready in parallel (same 7 business days).
3) Streaming connector (Kafka): optional, 3-4 weeks to configure and test.

Attachments provided with this email: export_schema_v1.csv, sample_manifest.txt, redaction_recipe.md.

Requested next steps from ClearSky:
- Confirm salt for pseudonymization and delivery S3 bucket name + IAM principal.
- Sign the runbook (we'll send via DocuSign) to authorize the export and HMAC key usage.
- Preferred auditor window (so we can schedule a short requery window).

I'll schedule a 30-minute handoff call with Ben and Kim tomorrow to walk through the runbook if that works.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
https://www.redwood.com

Attachments: export_schema_v1.csv, sample_manifest.txt, redaction_recipe.md
